blocks.content: Previously, you used aggregate window functions to calculate averages and totals. Now, your manager has a new request:
"Can you show how employee salaries compare? I want to see who earns the most and their ranking within the company."
Sorting alone won't be enough—you need to assign a rank to each employee while keeping all data intact.
This is where ranking window functions come in.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
